```{r}

library(scattermore)

tidymodels_prefer()

df<-read.csv("/home/yamorza/Documentos/espacio_trabajo_intro_analisis_dat2/proyecto_modulo_6/src/habits.csv")

df %>% dim()

df %>% glimpse()

df %>% head()
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_encoded <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Binary: Male = 0, Female = 1
    part_time_job = ifelse(part_time_job== "No",1,0),
    extracurricular_participation = ifelse(extracurricular_participation== "Yes",1,0),

    gender = ifelse(gender == "Male", 0, 1),
    
    # Ordinal: poor = 0, average = 1, good = 2
    internet_quality = case_when(
      internet_quality == "Poor" ~ 0,
      internet_quality == "Average" ~ 1,
      internet_quality == "Good" ~ 2
    ),
    
    # Same ordinal encoding
    diet_quality = case_when(
      diet_quality == "Poor" ~ 0,
      diet_quality == "Fair" ~ 1,
      diet_quality == "Good" ~ 2
    ),
    
    # Ordinal: None = 0, High School = 1, Bachelor = 2, Master = 3
    parental_education_level = case_when(
      parental_education_level == "None" ~ 0,
      parental_education_level == "High School" ~ 1,
      parental_education_level == "Bachelor" ~ 2,
      parental_education_level == "Master" ~ 3
    )
  )
```


```{r}

df_para_umap<- df_encoded %>%
  select(-c(exam_score))


df_umap <- df_para_umap %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  scale() %>%
  uwot::umap()
```


```{r}

datos <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = df_umap[,1],
  UMAP2 = df_umap[,2],
  diagnostico = df$exam_score
)

head(datos)

datos <- datos %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    diagnostico >= 80 ~ "Alto",
    diagnostico >= 60 ~ "Medio",
    diagnostico < 60 ~ "Bajo"
  )) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Alto", "Medio", "Bajo")))

ggplot(datos, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2E8B57") +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP - Estudiantes por Hábitos",
    x = "UMAP Dimensión 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimensión 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#4682B4", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#8B4513", size = 9)
  )

ggplot(datos, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Alto" = "#2E8B57", 
               "Medio" = "#FFD700", 
               "Bajo" = "#DC143C"),
    name = "Grupo de Calificación"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP - Estudiantes por Grupo de Calificación",
    x = "UMAP Dimensión 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimensión 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#4682B4", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#8B4513", size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```






```{r}
umap_rec <- recipe(~., data = df_encoded) %>%
  update_role(exam_score, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_umap(all_predictors())

umap_res <- prep(umap_rec)

umap_res

datos_umap <- juice(umap_res) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    exam_score >= 80 ~ "Alto",
    exam_score >= 60 ~ "Medio",
    exam_score < 60 ~ "Bajo"
  )) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Alto", "Medio", "Bajo")))

ggplot(datos_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2E8B57") +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP - Estudiantes por Hábitos",
    x = "UMAP Dimensión 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimensión 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#4682B4", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#8B4513", size = 9)
  )

ggplot(datos_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Alto" = "#2E8B57", 
               "Medio" = "#FFD700", 
               "Bajo" = "#DC143C"),
    name = "Grupo de Calificación"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP - Estudiantes por Grupo de Calificación",
    x = "UMAP Dimensión 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimensión 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#4682B4", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#8B4513", size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}

df_umap3 <- df_encoded %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  scale() %>%
  uwot::umap(n_components=3)

head(df_umap3)


umap_df3 <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = df_umap3[, 1],
  UMAP2 = df_umap3[, 2],
  UMAP3 = df_umap3[, 3],
  diagnostico = factor(df$exam_score)
)

head(umap_df3)

colors <- c("#2E8B57", "#FFD700","#DC143C")
hover_text <- paste(
  "diagnostico:", umap_df3$exam_score, "",
  "Dimension 1:", round(umap_df3$UMAP1, 3),
  "Dimension 2:", round(umap_df3$UMAP2, 3),
  "Dimension 3:", round(umap_df3$UMAP3, 3)
)

plot_ly(
  data = umap_df3,
  x = ~UMAP1,
  y = ~UMAP2,
  z = ~UMAP3,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 6),
  text = hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  color = ~diagnostico,
  colors = colors
) %>%
   plotly::layout(
    title = "UMAP_3D:WDBC ",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "UMAP Dimension 1"),
      yaxis = list(title = "UMAP Dimension 2"),
      zaxis = list(title = "UMAP Dimension 3")
    )
  )


```





```{r}


umap_params = expand.grid(n_neighbors = c(5,10, 20, 50, 100), min_dist = c(0.1,0.5, 0.75, 1.1))

umaps = lapply(seq(nrow(umap_params)), function(i) {
  emb = uwot::umap(
    X = df_para_umap,
    n_neighbors = umap_params$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist = umap_params$min_dist[i]
  )
  return(emb)
})

d = rbindlist(lapply(seq(nrow(umap_params)), function(i) {
  data.table(
    x = umaps[[i]][,1],
    y = umaps[[i]][,2],
    n_neighbors = umap_params$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist = umap_params$min_dist[i],
    exam_score = df$exam_score
  )
}))

d <- d %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    exam_score >= 80 ~ "Alto",
    exam_score >= 60 ~ "Medio",
    exam_score < 60 ~ "Bajo"
  )) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Alto", "Medio", "Bajo")))

p <- ggplot(d) +
  geom_scattermore(
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group),
    pointsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Alto" = "#2E8B57", 
               "Medio" = "#FFD700", 
               "Bajo" = "#DC143C"),
    name = "Grupo de Calificación"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(min_dist ~ n_neighbors,
             labeller = label_both,
             scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "UMAP - Comparación de Parámetros (n_neighbors y min_dist)")

print(p)

umap_params1 = expand.grid(n_neighbors = c(50, 100, 150, 200), min_dist = c(0.5, 0.75, 1.1))

umaps1 = lapply(seq(nrow(umap_params1)), function(i) {
  emb = uwot::umap(
    X = df_para_umap,
    n_neighbors = umap_params1$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist = umap_params1$min_dist[i]
  )
  return(emb)
})

d1 = rbindlist(lapply(seq(nrow(umap_params1)), function(i) {
  data.table(
    x = umaps1[[i]][,1],
    y = umaps1[[i]][,2],
    n_neighbors = umap_params1$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist = umap_params1$min_dist[i],
    exam_score = df$exam_score
  )
}))

d1 <- d1 %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    exam_score >= 80 ~ "Alto",
    exam_score >= 60 ~ "Medio",
    exam_score < 60 ~ "Bajo"
  )) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Alto", "Medio", "Bajo")))

p1 <- ggplot(d1) +
  geom_scattermore(
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group),
    pointsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Alto" = "#2E8B57", 
               "Medio" = "#FFD700", 
               "Bajo" = "#DC143C"),
    name = "Grupo de Calificación"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(min_dist ~ n_neighbors,
             labeller = label_both,
             scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "UMAP - Comparación de Parámetros (n_neighbors 50-200)")

print(p1)

colores_3 <- c("Alto" = "#2E8B57", "Medio" = "#FFD700", "Bajo" = "#DC143C")

anim_plot1 <- d1 %>%
  filter(n_neighbors %in% c(10, 20, 50, 100)) %>%
  mutate(parametros = factor(paste('n_neighbors:', n_neighbors, 'min_dist:', min_dist))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_scattermore(
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group),
    pointsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores_3, name = "Grupo") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#2E8B57", face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(title = 'UMAP - Exploración de Parámetros') +
  transition_states(parametros, transition_length = 2, state_length = 3) +
  labs(title = '{closest_state}')

animate(anim_plot1, nframes = 300, width = 800, height = 600)
anim_save("umap_animacion_1.gif", anim_plot1)

anim_plot2 <- d1 %>%
  filter(min_dist %in% c(0.5, 0.75, 1.1)) %>%
  mutate(parametros = factor(paste('n_neighbors:', n_neighbors, 'min_dist:', min_dist))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_scattermore(
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group),
    pointsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores_3, name = "Grupo") +
  theme(

  ) +
```
